system.description:
You control light in an area, making it darker or bright as you wish.

Choose a point within 10 spaces. You may choose the level of brightness / darkness for all spaces within a 5-space-radius of that point. All affected spaces have the same level of light.

If you choose to darken the space, choose either Total Darkness or Dim Light.

  • Total Darkness

    • Creatures in an affected space are Blinded.

    • All creatures within the space cannot be seen or targeted except by those adjacent to them.

  • Dim Light

    • The affected space becomes Obscured (2), increasing the difficulty of Perception checks to see into the space, and increasing the Defense of creatures within the space.

Creatures that can see in the dark are immune to this effect.

This effect lasts for until the start of your next turn.

Each extra success extends the duration by +1 rounds.

For each round that you maintain the effect, you may change the light level in the affected space at the start of your turn.
